title: Load XSLT into the editor
description: This verifies that importing an XSLT file populates the XSLT editor with the file contents.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the XSLT upload control
Upload a valid XSLT file
Verify the XSLT content is displayed in the editor

title: Transform XML and XSLT into a live invoice preview
description: This test verifies that entering valid XML and XSLT produces a live transformed invoice preview in the A4 frame.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Verify the invoice preview is displayed
Verify transformed invoice content is visible in the preview

title: Load XML into the editor
description: This verifies that importing an XML file populates the XML editor with the file contents.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the XML upload control
Upload a valid XML file
Verify the XML content is displayed in the editor

title: Drag XML or XSLT files into the workspace
description: This verifies that dropping supported files onto the workspace loads them into the appropriate editors.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Drag and drop a valid XML file onto the workspace
Drag and drop a valid XSLT file onto the workspace
Verify both files are loaded into the editors

title: Refresh the preview manually after disabling auto-refresh
description: This test verifies that turning off auto-refresh and using manual transform still updates the invoice preview correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Turn off auto-refresh
Click the manual transform control
Verify the invoice preview is updated
Verify transformed invoice content is visible in the preview

title: Open print or PDF output
description: This verifies that the user can open the print flow for the current invoice with A4-formatted output.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to open print or PDF output
Verify the print preview or print dialog opens with A4-formatted output

title: Open the print-friendly invoice view
description: This test verifies that the print action opens a print-friendly invoice view with A4-oriented formatting for output.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the print or PDF action
Verify a print-friendly invoice view is displayed
Verify A4-oriented print formatting is visible

title: Edit rendered invoice text inline and keep it in sync
description: Verifies that inline editing from the preview updates the displayed text and remains reflected in the source workflow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Double-click text in the invoice preview
Type new text inline
Commit the inline text edit
Verify the preview shows the updated text content
Verify the edited text remains reflected in the invoice editing workflow

title: Show validation feedback for invalid XSLT syntax
description: This test verifies that invalid XSLT input surfaces validation feedback and does not produce a successful transformed invoice preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type invalid XSLT into the XSLT editor
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify transformed invoice content is not visible

title: Save and reload a local template from the template library
description: This test verifies that a modified template can be saved locally and loaded again from the template library.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Open the template library
Save the current template to the library
Load the saved template from the library
Verify the loaded template is displayed in the editor and preview
Verify the template content matches the saved design

title: Style previewed invoice text and persist the visual change
description: Verifies that selecting a preview element and adjusting its visual styling updates the rendered invoice as expected.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an element in the invoice preview
Adjust the selected element's font size
Change the selected element's text color
Set the selected element's alignment
Verify the preview reflects the updated styling on the selected invoice content

title: Detect embedded XSLT and load the design
description: This verifies that XML with embedded XSLT is detected and can be loaded into the template design.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Load an XML file that contains embedded XSLT
Click the control to load the embedded design into the template
Verify the embedded design is loaded into the editor

title: Load a saved template from the library
description: Verifies that selecting a saved template loads it into the editor and preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the template library dropdown
Select a saved template
Load the selected template into the editor
Verify the loaded template content is displayed in the editor
Verify the invoice preview updates to match the loaded template

title: Switch between XML and XSLT editing modes
description: This test verifies that the user can move between XML and XSLT tabs and continue editing both source documents.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch to the XML editor tab
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Switch to the XSLT editor tab
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Verify both editors contain editable source content
Verify the preview area remains available

title: Jump from preview selection to XSLT source in inspector mode
description: Verifies that enabling inspector mode and selecting a preview element moves the code editor to the corresponding XSLT source location.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Turn on Koda Git mode
Click an element in the invoice preview
Verify the XSLT editor jumps to the linked source location for the selected element

title: Save the current template to the library
description: Verifies that entering a template name and saving stores the current template for later reuse.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type a unique template name
Click the control to save the template to the library
Verify a saved template confirmation is visible
Verify the new template appears in the template library

title: Edit invoice text directly in the preview and persist it back to source
description: This test verifies that inline text editing in the preview updates the invoice content and can be persisted back into the underlying XSLT source.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Click the invoice text in the preview to edit it inline
Type updated invoice text into the inline editor
Save the inline edit back to the source
Verify the updated invoice text is visible in the preview
Verify the edited content remains reflected in the invoice source view

title: Open text editing controls for the selected preview text
description: Verifies that the inline text editing action makes the selected text editable through the editor controls.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a text element in the invoice preview
Click Metni Düzenle
Verify the selected text becomes editable in the preview

title: Use split layout to review code and preview together

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the split workspace layout
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Verify the code editors are visible alongside the preview
Verify transformed invoice content is visible in the preview

title: Apply emphasis styling to selected invoice text
description: Verifies that bold, italic, and underline toggles update the selected preview text correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an element in the invoice preview
Toggle bold styling for the selected element
Toggle italic styling for the selected element
Toggle underline styling for the selected element
Verify the selected preview text displays the applied emphasis styles

title: Preview watermark changes immediately
description: Verifies that configuring a watermark updates the invoice preview with the chosen watermark settings.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter watermark text with a unique value
Select a watermark color
Adjust the watermark rotation to a visible angle
Adjust the watermark size to a visible value
Adjust the watermark opacity to a visible value
Toggle watermark visibility on
Verify the invoice preview shows the configured watermark

title: Add an image to the invoice template
description: This test verifies that a user can add a new image asset and see it appear in the invoice preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new image
Add a valid image file
Verify the image is displayed in the design preview

title: Remove a selected invoice element from the preview
description: Verifies that deleting the selected preview element removes it from the rendered invoice.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an element in the invoice preview
Click Bu Elemanı Sil
Verify the selected element is no longer visible in the preview

title: Apply a style change from the preview designer
description: This test verifies that changing a visible invoice style in designer mode updates the preview layout as expected.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type valid invoice XML into the XML editor
Type valid invoice XSLT into the XSLT editor
Select an invoice element in the preview
Change a visible style property for the selected element
Verify the selected invoice element reflects the style change
Verify the updated styling is visible in the preview

title: Insert a nested element into the selected invoice region
description: Verifies that adding a nested element from the preview creates a new visible element in the design.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an element in the invoice preview
Click İçine Ekle
Verify a new nested element appears in the preview within the selected area

title: Replace the selected image

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new image
Add a valid image file
Select the image in the preview
Click the control to replace the selected image
Add a different valid image file
Verify the selected image has been updated in the design preview

title: Save watermark into the template source

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter watermark text with a unique value
Select a watermark color
Toggle watermark visibility on
Click the control to save the watermark into the XSLT
Verify the watermark is present in the saved template source

title: Download the current output file

Verify saved template information is displayed
